pages.text: The $(item)beekeeper's post$(): made with a beehive. Fence in a yard.

pages.title: Hives
pages.text: I set the hives and plant the flowers myself. The hives fill with no bee in them that I can touch, quicker with more flowers, up to $(thing)11$().$(br2)Use the post to choose what a full hive becomes: honey into a cask, a bottle if there are bottles, or comb. A bottle held to a cask of honey fills.
